papers.title: Influence of Scanning on Nano Crystalline β-Ti Alloys Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting and Their Applications in Biomedical Science
papers.abstract: titanium alloys. We have applied cross-scan strategy for improving mechanical properties and lower elastic modulus of SLMed Ti-20Mg-5Ta alloys which has been shown to be altering the microstructure and refining the grain size. The cross-scan strategy can refine the microstructure and induce various deformation textures in contrast to the conventional scan strategy. The microstructures of Ti-20Mg-5Ta alloys indicate that the cross-scan strategy will yield the best mechanical properties and lower elastic modulus. The corrosion behavior of the Ti-20Mg-5Ta alloys was studied during immersion in an acellular simulated body fluid (SBF) at 37±0.50 °C for 28 days. Both the mechanical and bioactive properties showed that the novel Ti-20Mg-5Ta alloys should be ideal for bone implants.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti-20Mg-5Ta合金的跨扫描策略对力学性能和弹性模量的影响，但未涉及多孔结构或疲劳性能。
llm.why_not_core: Does not investigate porous structures, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration; focuses on solid alloy property optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发低弹性模量、高强度的Ti合金骨植入材料
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM交叉扫描策略制备Ti-20Mg-5Ta合金，表征微观结构和性能
summary_zh.result: 交叉扫描细化晶粒，降低弹性模量，提高力学性能和耐腐蚀性
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和SBF浸泡腐蚀实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop Ti alloys with low elastic modulus and high strength for bone implants.
summary_en.method: Ti-20Mg-5Ta alloys were fabricated by SLM using a cross-scan strategy, and microstructures and properties were characterized.
summary_en.result: Cross-scanning refined grains, reduced elastic modulus, and improved mechanical properties and corrosion resistance.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and immersion corrosion tests in simulated body fluid.
